scientific_context: TrpB synthesizes tryptophan from indole and serine. The public benchmark contains growth-based fitness measurements over ten combinatorial sub-landscapes spanning 20 engineered positions.
source_partition: Official train and validation variants with zero or one mutation.
deployment_partition: Official test variants with more than one mutation.
optimization_endpoint: Best-so-far growth-fitness AUC under three initial target observations and twelve additional reveals.
evidence_constraint: Official test fitness values are unavailable to the planner, calibration gate, skill selector, candidate sampler, and protocol author at freeze time.
finite_pool_rule: Within each official partition, retain at most 5,000 sequences with the lexicographically smallest SHA-256 sequence hashes. The rule uses sequence only and is frozen before download.
candidate_skill: A bounded additive mutation prior learned only from completed low-order source outcomes and blended with target-only GP-UCB using fixed decaying authority.
primary_mechanism_null: The true source sequence-outcome assignment is no better than deterministic permutations of the same source outcomes across the same source sequences.
source: Didi et al., FLIP2, ICML 2026 Spotlight; official FLIP2 website and download asset.
